figures.alt: Window sash prepared on a padded surface beside an intact insulated replacement pane
figures.caption: Replacement glass needs the right measurements, construction, and safe handling plan. Protect the sash and nearby surfaces before the old pane or unit is removed.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Raised single-hung sash exposing balance hardware and a jamb channel
figures.caption: Window glass is only one part of the assembly. Check how the sash, balances, frame, and weather seals are working before assuming a pane is the entire repair.

figures.alt: Finished exterior window trim with a sloped sill and narrow caulk joint
figures.caption: After glass work, recheck the exterior water-control details. A cracked pane can be obvious while a failed sill joint or soft surrounding trim remains the longer-term concern.
